messages:
alex-pm: Heads-up for sprint planning — we need to pick the next model onboarding batch. Proposing a quick RICE pass + a short perf spike before we lock anything.
sara-product: +1. Customer signal: 3 paying customers already asked for lower-latency Llama-3 for chat. Likely high impact but infra/cost unknown.
devin-ml: I can run a throughput/latency spike tomorrow. Checklist idea: quantize to 4-bit, measure p50/p95, estimate token cost delta.
mike-ops: Ops note: dedicated pool is tight. Pinning a heavier model may evict ~2k qps from existing jobs. Need cost delta before we commit.
tanya-eng: Engineering risk: Mistral quantization had a KV-cache race last month. Need a gating regression test before any onboard.
alex-pm: Proposed RICE inputs: Reach=3-10 customers, Impact=0.6, Confidence=0.5 (perf unknown), Effort=3 dev-weeks. Thoughts?
sara-product: OK but add explicit launch criteria: p95 < 400ms hosted, embedding nDCG >= baseline +3%, infra delta <$20k / month per region.
devin-ml: Will run spike. Plan: 1h run, script: ```bash
./spike.sh --model llama3-7b --quant 4bit --warmup 100 --load 100qps
```
mike-ops: :thumbsup: Reserving GPU slot 09:00-15:00 PST tomorrow. Need exact AMI/image & container tag.
tanya-eng: I'll add a gating test at `evals/regression/embedding_quality.py` — standard eval set, auto-fail if nDCG drops.
catalog-bot: Catalog state: Mistral-v1 (stable), Llama-3-7B (candidate). No pinned variants. Recommend tagging canary if spike passes.
alex-pm: Decision (tentative): run the spike. If p95 < 400ms and cost delta < 20% we onboard Llama-3-7B as a canary next sprint; otherwise fallback to Mistral quantized. I'll capture this in the roadmap.
sara-product: I'll notify CS to prep customer comms & docs. Action items: Devin spike, Tanya gating test, Mike reserve infra, Sara notify CS. ETA: EOD tomorrow initial numbers.
devin-ml: I'll post logs, p50/p95 and token-cost estimate back in this thread.
mike-ops: Slot booked. AMI hash: `ami-0abc1234`. Container tag: `redwood/infer:canary-2026-03-01`.
tanya-eng: PR for gating tests wip -> https://git/repo/pull/456 :eyes:
catalog-bot: Reminder: add onboarding tag `canary-llama3-7b-2026-03` if spike passes.
alex-pm: :white_check_mark: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the spike and finalize RICE. Closing for now.
